note: Skeptic eye checks, 27 Nov 2026. right = finder4's new text is text; wrong = it is not text; unsure = cannot tell. Pictures in skeptic/pics (scan | finder3 | finder4 with new text magenta | truth where a sealed crop covers it).

straight_edge.png.what: the 30 px of the straight-run rise on SA-F1 (plate 38), gate's measure
straight_edge.png.verdict: All 30 px lie within 16 px of the crop's right edge (x 5736). With cv2's default border (outside = ink) short strokes at the edge count as 61 px runs. With the real plate ink beyond the edge the rise is 11 px; with outside = paper it is 9 px. The px are real false text (the arc of a round symbol with pink fill, and a bit of a thick vertical line by a small box), but tiny.

miss_0..3.png.what: every target finder4 misses (3 block numbers, 24 dittos)
miss_0..3.png.verdict: The truth is fair for most. Doubtful: SA-D04-002, SA-D07-002, SA-D08-002 (marks beside the plate-6 railroad with cross ticks; p6_rail_dittos.png), SB-D16-011 (an x-shaped mark, flagged unsure by its builder), SA-D38-002 (a square blob, could be a dot). The plate-6 one-blob marks in brick buildings (SA-D34-004, D36-004, D37-002, D37-003, D38-002) are single blobs near the top wall: plausible merged dittos, but a ruling is needed. Clear misses: SA-D26-003, SB-D04-001, SB-D01-006, SB-D02-002, SB-D06-003, SB-D07-001, SB-D13-007, SA-D21-007, SB-D03-006, SB-D02-003, SA-D22-001, SA-D39-001. Block misses SA-B08 (thin 19 on a lot-line crossing), SA-B20 (1 against a vertical line), SB-B25 (5 over the plate-92 grid) are real misses; SB-B25 is doubtful truth.
